d: The first perspective is 'the world, almost a chaos, that distinguished the countryside of Florence with Arno, and you see descend into a cloud Hymenaeus, Honestness, and Fecundity, to fill the serene spouses of 'their goods. Hymenaeus, Honestness, and Fecundity.
Heaven is opened, Jupiter is seen seated in his throne, and many Numi around. Jupiter, Mercury, and Chorus of Heavenly Numi.
The prospect is turned into thicket; Diana with six of her Nymphs seek an injured deer. Diana with six of her Nymphs.
Nerine, Chlori with four other nymphs, and the same.
Mercury, and the same.

The prospect turns into snow-covered mountains, in the middle appears the forge of Vulcano, which from the top exhales flames, and opening to the sound of hammers Vulcano goes out with sixteen his ministers. Vulcano, Sterope, Bronte, Pirammone, and Chorus of Vulcano.
Iride descends from heaven, and the same.
Mount Parnaso appears, where the Muse while singing, and playing are met by Pallaso. Pallaso, and the Muse.
Mercury, Pallas, Muse Choir.
The scene turns into the garden of Venus. Venus, Adonis, three Graces, Rice, Scherzo, Game, Chorus of 14 Love, and six Shepherds of Adonis.
Mercury, and the same.
Juno appears in the air on the chariot pulled by his peacocks. Juno, the same, and four winds.
The scene changes, the stage opens, Pluto rises over a dragon with many Numi, and infernal monsters. Pluto, Chorus of Hell Numi.
Parks, and the same.
Mars.
Venus, his Choir, and Mars.
Cupid, and themselves.
Neptune comes over a chariot pulled by sea horses followed by many tritons. Neptune, his choir of sea gods, and themselves.
Nero, Anfitrite, Melicerta, and the same.
Venus, his Choir, and the same.
The scene of Venus' amenity returns, but varied in the hole. Parks descend from the sky singing.
Venus, his Choir, and Parks.
Perspective, and hell. Pluto, his Choir, and Parks.
The perspective is changed and Ceres' palace appears on a lawn from which Proserpina comes out with Venus, and his Chorus. Proserpina, Venus, and his Chorus.
Venus flees, and Chorus; Pluto arrives to kidnap ProserpinaPluto, and Proserpina.
Heaven is opened, and Jupiter appears with many heavenly Numi. Jupiter, Diana, Mercury, and the choir of heavenly Gods.
Venus, it's the same.
Mars, Volcano, and themselves.
The sky is closed and Ceres appear in the air on the wagon pulled by dragons, who is looking for the daughter Proserpina. Ceres.
The cave of Vulcano opens. Volcano, and his choir.
Two clouds appear, one from the right hand, and the other from the left, in one is the Chorus of Venus in Mars favor, in the other is the Chorus of Juno for Vulcan.
Mercury, Juno, and Venus.

The whole scene is divine sea, from the middle appears a rock of corals, and pearls where Neptune sits, and Anfitrite, from all sides rise gods, and nymphs marine. Neptune, Anfitrite, Choir of sea gods.
Hymenaeus, and themselves.
All perspective shows hell. Pluto, Proserpina, and choir of Hell's Numi.
In Ceres' chariot, it descends with Mercury into hell. Ceres, and Mercury.
Hymenaeus, and themselves.

It becomes the whole sky scene opening from the right, and from the left side: in the air you see a great distance, and many Numi who in opening the sky from above begin to sing. Jupiter his Chorus, and Universal Choir.
14 nymphs of Juno before her chariot appear thus singing.
Vulcan choir before him, which goes on the chariot of fire pulled by lions.
choir of Venus before her, which goes on the wagon pulled by swans.
